adjudication.rationale: The migration `CreateEmbeddableHosts` creates `embeddable_hosts` with `host` and `category_id` but adds neither an index on `host` nor a foreign key on `category_id` (no `add_index`, no `add_foreign_key`). The new request-path check uses `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host`/`host_allowed?` which runs `where("lower(host) = ?", host).first`, implying an unindexed lookup can devolve into a full-table scan. The orphan-category/PostCreator “blows up” claim is plausible given `TopicEmbed.import` passes `category: eh.try(:category_id)`, but the diff doesn’t prove PostCreator will raise on a missing category, so that part can’t be verified as a definite defect.
